subject: Senior signoff: Project Saffron — private hosting carveout & audit scope
messages:
From: Aditi Rao <aditi.rao@saffronhealth.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Michael Chen <mchen@saffronhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Project Saffron — private deployment + audit request

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We’re excited about Redwood for inference in our clinical NLP pipelines. Procurement asked me to surface two items before we move to contract:

- Saffron requires hosting inside a dedicated VPC in us-west-2 (no cross-region backups).
- We have a standard audit clause: annual auditor access (timeboxed to 2 business days) and a limited audit plan focused on data residency + access logs.

We also discussed pricing — our finance team is asking whether Redwood can offer a 15% list discount tied to a 24-month committed Dedicated package. Happy to share an initial mutual action plan (attached).

Could you confirm feasibility and whether this needs leadership signoff? We aim to have a paper-ready term sheet by end of next week.

Best,
Aditi Rao
VP, Strategic Programs
Saffron Health

Attachment: Saffron_MutualActionPlan.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Aditi Rao <aditi.rao@saffronhealth.com>, Michael Chen <mchen@saffronhealth.com>
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Project Saffron — private deployment + audit request

Thanks Aditi — appreciated. Looping in Lauren (Legal) and Karthik (Product/Private deployments) to confirm guardrails.

High-level responses:
- VPC-only deployment in us-west-2 is feasible; we’ll need to validate backup/replication settings to guarantee no cross-region replication.
- Audit access: we can support a timeboxed on-site or remote auditor review focused on access logs and controls. We typically require an approved audit plan and an NDA for third-party auditors.
- Discount: I’ll surface your 15% request to Deal Desk and Leadership; scope (term length, seats, and run-rate) will affect approvals.

Can you send the mutual action plan with proposed timelines? I’ve attached a short intake form for the audit plan (Saffron_AuditScope_Draft.pdf) — fill what you can and I’ll route internally.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Saffron_AuditScope_Draft.pdf (doc stub)

From: lauren.bishop@redwood.com
To: priyom.das@redwood.com, lauren.bishop@redwood.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 14:12:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Project Saffron — private deployment + audit request

Priyom / team — I reviewed the requested clauses. Key points for Deal Desk / Exec review: 

1) Data residency / backups: we can commit to in-region hosting (us-west-2) and to disable automatic cross-region backups, provided the customer accepts longer RPO options and we document recovery procedures in the runbook.

2) Audit scope: accept timeboxed auditor access for log review and controls verification. Redwood requires:
   - Approved audit plan & list of auditor IDs 7 business days prior
   - Standard redaction for customer PII in evidence export
   - On-site auditors must be accompanied by our security engineer; remote access requires jumpbox audit session logs.

3) Contractual limits: we can accept a 1x/year audit and 2-business-day window, but any expansion (additional days or unscoped evidence requests) will require SOC 2-level review and deal re-escalation.

4) Commercial ask: Saffron requested 15% off list for a 24-month Dedicated commitment. For that discount level we need Deal Desk approval and Exec signoff only if the net effective margin falls below our committed threshold. Provide estimated ARR / committed spend and we’ll route.

Recommended next step: Priyom, please assemble the mutual action plan with expected committed spend and runbook acceptance point. I’ll prepare an exceptions memo for Deal Desk and copy Aditya for final signoff.

-Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Head of Contracts, Redwood Inference

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Project Saffron — private deployment + audit request

Lauren, Karthik — thanks. Attaching the mutual action plan (finalized) and a short commercial summary below: 

- Commitment: 24 months Dedicated (single tenant VPC, us-west-2)
- Estimated committed spend: $1,080,000 over 24 months (baseline)
- Requested commercial: 15% off list, plus waiver of standard 30-day audit notice for the first annual audit (customer requests 7-day notice)

Attachments: Saffron_MutualActionPlan.xlsx (final)

Requesting Aditya’s signoff on the following exceptions:
A) 15% discount for 24-month commit (Deal ID DEAL-2027-0451)
B) Approve 7-day advance notice for the first audit (exception to standard 30-day notice)
C) Approve in-region-only replication (no cross-region backups) with documented RPO tradeoffs

Aditya — can you confirm whether we have flexibility on (A) given the commit size and (B) as a one-time concession for a strategic health customer?

Thanks,
Priyom

On attachments: Saffron_MutualActionPlan.xlsx

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: priyom.das@redwood.com, lauren.bishop@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 11:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: RE: Project Saffron — private deployment + audit request

Thanks team — reviewed the ask. My decisions: 

1) Commercial (A): Approved a 12.5% list discount (compromise). Requirement: E2E commitment letter signed with payment milestones at 30/60/90 days after start, and a staged rollback clause if infra usage exceeds projected thresholds (we’ll cap sustained burst costs). Deal Desk to finalize margin table.

2) Audit notice (B): Approved a one-time 7-day notice for the first audit only, provided the audit plan is submitted 10 business days prior to the audit and Redwood’s security engineer is present during the session. Any deviation will revert to 30-day notice.

3) Replication (C): Approve in-region-only hosting with explicit RPO/RTO tradeoffs recorded in the runbook. Customer must sign off on the runbook and acknowledge responsibility for cross-region DR (we will provide export guidance).

Conditions to capture in exceptions memo:
- 12.5% discount approval tied to DEAL-2027-0451 and to a non-cancellable 24-month revenue commitment.
- Approval expires if the customer reduces committed compute by >20% before start date.
- Legal to prepare contract language limiting audit evidence scope to logs and configuration metadata; any PII extraction requires redaction & separate approval.

I’ll sign the exceptions memo once Legal drafts it. Priyom — please confirm you’ll communicate the revised commercial to the customer and get written acceptance.

—Aditya
Aditya Rao
VP, Sales Operations

From: Aditi Rao <aditi.rao@saffronhealth.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Michael Chen <mchen@saffronhealth.com>
Cc: procurement@saffronhealth.com
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Project Saffron — private deployment + audit request

Priyom — thanks for the quick turnaround and to Aditya for the decision. Saffron accepts the revised commercial and exceptions as outlined: 12.5% discount, first-audit 7-day notice with plan submission, in-region hosting w/ RPO acknowledgement.

Please route the exceptions memo and contract redlines; procurement will countersign once DocuSign is ready. Sending the signature authority list shortly.

Best,
Aditi
VP, Strategic Programs
Saffron Health

Attachments referenced: Saffron_MutualActionPlan.xlsx, Saffron_AuditScope_Draft.pdf
